summary: Today’s feed looks cautiously mixed: Bitcoin and a few majors are still getting structural bullish support, but analysts are also flagging bearish retests, weak altcoin breadth, and fragile short-term momentum. The clearest fresh opportunities appear concentrated in select alts and a few high-beta bounce setups rather than broad market euphoria.
